title: A volcano field in a step-over
text: The Coso Volcanic Field lies east of the Sierra Nevada, between Owens Valley and the Garlock Fault, in the Basin and Range province. It sits in a releasing step-over between the Little Lake fault and the Owens Valley fault, both active right-lateral strike-slip faults. Mesozoic plutonic and metamorphic rocks like those of the southern Sierra Nevada underlie the area, and the hot fluids are trapped in these fractured rocks.
